description: Department of Local Government  - North Central Province - Notify the First Meeting of the Kebitigollewa and 12 other Local Government Bodies in North Central Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the schedule for the first official meetings to appoint Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen for various Local Government Authorities, following local elections. It is issued under the Local Authorities Election Ordinance and its amendments, making it clearly related to electoral processes and post-election procedures, which falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
